goal: Maximize complete own-current-turn exact candidate enumeration throughput for learning/evaluation relative to native at 47eb2ef8d843dcc7c20d13f70a2a51eabf21a087, preserving every candidate equivalence class, incomparable alternatives, exact random probabilities and decisions conditional on observed outcomes. Demonstrate further measured improvement and an evidence-based search across substantially different optimization approaches; do not claim absolute optimality from a finite experiment.
persona: Python AI engineer consuming complete candidate JSON and conditional actions for learning/evaluation on the prepared Windows host.
public_entry: PowerShell at repository root: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -X utf8 -m svdeck.battle_frontier_compare --cases JSON --output UNUSED_DIR --algorithms native. Public contracts: docs/battle-frontier.md and docs/battle-frontier-compare.md; conditional continuation uses the documented --expand/--candidate/--steps/--state commands.
test_data: input-manifest.v1.json pins the same independent-small, independent-medium and independent-hard JSON fixtures and frozen independent oracle as turn-search-speed: nine small cases, three medium cases and two original 5v5 hard cases. Preserve fixture bytes, all case fields and current-turn stopping horizon.

The immutable predecessor for all fresh comparisons is Git 47eb2ef8d843dcc7c20d13f70a2a51eabf21a087. Prepare a separate checkout with the same interpreter/dependency versions as delivered code. Record actual imported module paths and source hashes so an editable installation cannot silently select another checkout.

The historical complete candidate outputs are the delivered outputs under output/turn-search-speed-acceptance-v2; input-manifest.v1.json pins the actual result/report/manifest bytes and source provenance from docs/evidence/turn-search-speed/acceptance-v2. Their manifests record ca50628d4d0d88a44b36d2b32b86a7f37e3250ef. Preserve that recorded provenance: design-time source-hash checks did not establish full equality to 47eb2ef, even allowing LF/CRLF conversion. These are serialized-output regression evidence, never fresh baseline timing or mislabeled 47eb2ef measurements.

Small runs use --algorithms native --trials 1 --debug-threshold 1000000 --witness-samples 100 --max-states 100000000 --seconds 3600 for both versions. Medium/hard performance runs use --algorithms native --trials 3 --debug-threshold 0 --witness-samples 100 --max-states 100000000 --seconds 3600 identically for both versions. Use the delivered public CLI and --output unused directories; the whole journey has a separate fixed 60-minute observation deadline.

Reuse the frozen independent small-oracle results after checking hashes and fixture correspondence, or rerun scripts/turn_frontier_reference.py for small cases. No slow Python full-graph hard baseline, unrelated cache method, or new holdout suite is required. Neither production native nor predecessor native alone is an independent oracle.

For compact fixed-slots-v1 outputs, identical encoding, identical canonical complete record (including all cards and initial state), same hash-pinned input case and exhaustive equality of the complete integer-row multiset constitute a stronger exact serialized-state regression check than semantic digest equality alone. Independently hash actual rows as specified below; do not infer a decoder layout or import native implementation. Any row/record/encoding difference requires exhaustive decoded semantic equality via documented public expansion or an independent reader based on a supplied public schema; unchanged product digests alone cannot waive the difference.

Development evidence must already be retained before this acceptance starts. It must describe at least three substantively different optimization approaches or variants and their correctness/performance adoption or rejection decisions, include rejected work, and provide raw commands, source identities, timing and memory/allocation evidence with units and measurement scope. The number three is an evidence floor for breadth, not the optimization objective or a stopping rule. The fresh executor reads this ledger only after recording its independent CLI observations and F1-F6/U1-U3 findings; it must not read production source or diffs.
minimal_test_count_rationale: One stateful public-CLI journey covers candidate use, conditional random continuation, exact cross-version comparison, reserved-host performance measurement and use of the final evidence report. Splitting this workflow would duplicate provenance checks and risk concurrent timing interference.

tests.title: Consume exact candidates and assess the furthest evidenced native speed improvement
tests.user_task: Obtain complete reusable candidates and adaptive random continuations through the delivered public CLI, then determine whether complete-work hard compute medians improve relative to the immutable predecessor and whether the retained optimization evidence justifies the delivered choice and stated limits.
setup: Fresh PowerShell terminal at repository root with prepared performance Python environment; no login/browser required. Use unused output directories, separate predecessor/delivered source provenance, frozen fixture/oracle inputs and this validated lock. Executor is fresh and received no production source, diffs, intended measured result or prior acceptance verdict.

Reserve the host for one measured worker at a time; pause competing benchmark, oracle and compile work. Record host, interpreter/dependencies, both source identities, fixture bytes, command arguments, actual imported paths, process isolation and competing-load note. Record preexisting JIT cache state; each public case/version invocation has one separate automatic one-state warmup excluded from measured trials.

Freeze the score before opening new timings: sum the per-case median compute_seconds for the two hard cases, using all three complete measured trials of each case/version. Delivered sum must be strictly lower than fresh predecessor sum. Report each hard and medium median/range and any per-case regression. Non-overlapping ranges may support stronger confidence; overlapping ranges require an explicit uncertainty statement and never prove a universal fastest method.

Start one original monotonic journey timer at the first product invocation after preflight confirms dependencies and immutable inputs. Complete all required public observations, raw-output consumption, independent comparisons, evidence audit and report within 60 minutes. No product edits, retries, omitted trials, timer resets or carryover observations from prior acceptance. On expiry stop only journey-owned workers by verified PID/descendant identity and retain outputs; do not delete historical inputs or touch unrelated processes.
actions: Read public help/docs. Run one delivered suite command on all nine small cases using the fixed small options, then run the same suite once from the immutable predecessor with identical options. Each case/version has one excluded automatic warmup and one measured fresh-process trial. Using an independent ordinary-JSON consumer, compare every delivered canonical candidate with the frozen independent oracle projection and compare all advertised debug states and legal action/outcome distributions to oracle semantics, never traversal IDs. Replay every available delivered candidate witness through the documented public replay API or conditional command. Retain both versions of small timing/memory output to identify small-input regressions; single-trial small comparisons are descriptive.

On random_bad_outcome_retained, random_sequential_duplicate_outcomes and independent_random_then_chosen_remove, consume all exact rational probabilities. For the adaptive fixture, expand the saved root, retain each observed random branch and invoke --state or --steps to choose a different legal follow-up target after different observations. Save chosen actions and decoded outcomes; use --steps when validating root reachability. Make one delivered tiny-budget run on a one-case subset of hard_full_board_branching_1 with --trials 1 --max-states 1 --seconds 3600 --debug-threshold 0 and consume its explicit incomplete status/cause. Its warmup/trial are diagnostic and excluded from all performance scores.

Create one-case JSON subsets preserving every case value and pin subset hashes plus their original fixture correspondence. In fixture order, medium case 0 runs predecessor then delivered; medium case 1 delivered then predecessor; medium case 2 predecessor then delivered. Then hard case 0 runs delivered then predecessor and hard case 1 predecessor then delivered. Every one of these ten serial public CLI invocations uses --trials 3 and the fixed performance options. Its one automatic one-state warmup is excluded, followed by three consecutive measured fresh-process trials. Exactly 18 medium and 12 hard measured workers and ten warmups are retained. Log command, code version, case, warmup and each trial start/end order; do not use internal workers, invent skip-warmup control, repeat slow trials or change trial order after inspecting timings.

Read every medium/hard saved candidate result with an independent ordinary-JSON consumer. Check all completion flags/cutoffs, native backend, candidate_count == len(candidates), and equality of product semantic digests, but do not treat those digests as recomputed proof. For fixed-slots-v1, require the same encoding and canonical complete record across all three delivered/predecessor/historical outputs for each case; validate embedded cards and initial state against the hash-pinned fixture/public record contract and compare decoded roots using documented --expand. Require every row to be a list of integers (reject booleans and non-integers), and consistent row width within and across that case. Encode each entire row as json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8'), sort the byte strings lexicographically retaining duplicates, and hash the concatenation of each row length as an unsigned 8-byte big-endian integer followed by its complete bytes, using SHA256. Record row count, distinct count, row width, encoding, canonical-record hash and this independently computed full-row-multiset hash for every output, and require exact agreement across every fresh trial and every corresponding frozen historical result. Canonical-record JSON uses ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'). This reader must not call production hashing or read only product digest fields. No sampled rows, dropped columns or set deduplication is permitted. If encoding, record or rows differ, do not waive them as harmless: exhaustively decode every candidate through the documented public expansion or an independently implemented decoder with supplied public schema, and independently recompute every semantic key and candidate multiset to establish exact equality; otherwise F4 remains unproven. Full-state-v1 outputs require exhaustive independently computed canonical semantic-key multiset equality using the public comparator contract. Keep small independent-oracle proof separate from these complete-output regression checks.

Consume top-level summaries and every raw report with a separate ordinary-JSON reader. Recompute medium and hard per-case median/min/max from all three trials, the hard sum of medians and delivered/predecessor ratio. Retain compute, individual phase diagnostics, serialization, process/worker wall time, startup/exit and whole-process peak RSS for each trial with method/units. Include each small single-trial timing and memory pair in the report. Cross-check worker timing against an external monotonic process clock. Record F1-F6 and U1-U3 findings before opening the development ledger.

Then audit the retained development evidence without reading production source or diffs: identify the substantively different approaches/variants, the mechanism each attempted to improve, correctness observations, raw timed/memory/allocation observations, and adoption/rejection decisions. Require at least three distinct approaches or variants, including rejected work; repeated runs, changed analysis budgets or fewer exported states do not count as different optimizations. Cite final bottleneck evidence and remaining limits or untested approaches. Produce one compact comparison table plus the evidence links; keep the measured acceptance decision independent of the development narrative. If required work is unfinished at 60 minutes, acceptance is INCOMPLETE, never PASS.
functional_expectations: F1: Every normal small, medium and hard required run has complete=true, enumeration_complete=true, frontier_complete=true and empty cutoffs, with native backend identified. All nine delivered small candidate sets equal the independent oracle projection exactly; all advertised debug state/action/outcome data equal corresponding oracle semantics. Counts or product digest fields alone are not equality proof.

F2: Candidate equivalence preserves the documented resource/board relation and all incomparable alternatives: exact remaining hand identities, ability/effect/evolution differences, ordered follower behavior/count, remaining attacks, played turn and PP/EP/SEP or attack/health tradeoffs. No scalar top-k, favorable-outcome filtering, prefix-only work or next-turn/opponent/end_turn action substitutes for complete own-turn stopping candidates.

F3: Every tested random action retains all favorable and unfavorable outcomes with exact rational mass summing to 1; repeated draws can merge only by exact mass addition. Adaptive random fixture continuation allows different legal subsequent actions after observing different outcomes, and replay reaches the saved branch state. Witnesses remain conditional examples, not selectable luck or unconditional reachability probability.

F4: Every medium/hard canonical candidate set matches predecessor and historical complete output, verified independently from every actual saved candidate. For unchanged fixed-slots-v1 encoding and canonical embedded record from the same pinned fixture, equal complete integer-row multisets (including multiplicity) meet this condition; report this specifically as serialized-state equality, not an independently recomputed product semantic digest or a new independent hard oracle. Any record, encoding, traversal/row or witness-representative change is harmless only after exhaustive decoded semantic equality and legal conditional replay have actually been established; a product digest match cannot substitute. Historical evidence retains its original source/environment provenance and is never promoted to fresh timing.

F5: Delivered sum of the two hard per-case median complete compute_seconds is strictly less than the fresh 47eb2ef8d843dcc7c20d13f70a2a51eabf21a087 sum; each median uses all three measured fresh-process trials. Compute includes parsing/normalization, setup/cached JIT loading, enumeration, pruning/materialization, semantic hashing and required cleanup. JSON serialization and total process wall time are retained separately rather than subtracted or hidden. All raw small/medium/hard timings and whole-process peak RSS values with method/units are retained; per-case speed or memory regressions, including small inputs, are disclosed. Report hard/medium observed ranges and overlapping aggregate range uncertainty; finite host-specific improvement does not establish statistical significance, universal speed superiority or absolute optimality.

F6: Historical fixtures/oracle/raw evidence is hash-pinned and correctly attributed. Fresh medium and hard have exactly three retained measured fresh-process trials per case/version and one excluded automatic warmup per case/version; ten performance invocations are serial in the fixed case-level version order. Small has one retained trial plus one warmup per case/version. The tiny-budget diagnostic is explicitly incomplete with cause. No missing/error/incomplete normal output can win. All required steps and comparisons finish within the fixed 60-minute journey deadline, without retry, timer reset or product edits; otherwise acceptance cannot be PASS.

F7: The final choice is supported by retained development evidence for at least three substantively different approaches or variants, including adopted and rejected work, each with source identity, command/workload/options, correctness observation and performance decision linked to raw evidence. Report observed time, whole-process memory and allocation behavior; distinguish Python-only allocation instrumentation from native/whole-process memory, and distinguish measured counts/bytes from estimates. At minimum provide an actual allocation profile/trace or measured allocation metric for predecessor and final on a disclosed comparable workload outside scored trials; unavailable total native allocation counts must be stated, never inferred from RSS. The report names the dominant remaining cost from phase/profile evidence and identifies unresolved limits or untested approaches. Meeting the evidence count alone is neither an optimization goal nor proof that further improvement is impossible.
ux_checks: U1: Starting from the public CLI documentation in the terminal, help plus one suite command (at most two product invocations) produces normal small candidate output without production-source edits or internal imports. Directly log the commands. Repeated benchmark and independent validation commands are a separate measurement workflow and are not counted against this ordinary-use limit.

U2: Opening the saved top-level summaries and follow-up comparison table is sufficient to identify old/new source version, workload, completion, candidate agreement, each hard/medium median and range, compute seconds, serialization seconds, peak RSS with units, hard-score ratio and any small-input regression, without opening a raw state graph. A separate standard JSON reader resolves every retained raw-trial path. Record fields/paths actually consumed.

U3: Documented --expand plus --state or --steps suffices to decode and continue the adaptive fixture with no production-source edits. Record actual commands/outcomes and state whether the CLI/artifacts are usable as delivered and their largest remaining usability problem. This CLI-only journey has no viewport/click/scroll/focus or interactive response-time SLA. F5 is the explicit performance condition, measured over the documented compute interval and cross-checked by an external monotonic process wall clock.
impossible_if: The prepared runtime, immutable predecessor or pinned fixtures/oracle cannot be supplied before invocation, or no safe timing/whole-process peak-memory observation channel exists. A command crash, timeout, incomplete output, incorrect candidates, missing development evidence or no speed improvement is an observed failure/incomplete result, not impossibility.
tests.isolation_requirements: One independent executor with unique output directories and separate predecessor/delivered source provenance; no shared source/fixture edits. All measured workers run serially on the reserved host, with no parallel benchmark/oracle/compilation work. Ordinary validation may resume between measured batches.

budget.basis: One delivered plus one predecessor nine-case small suite, public conditional/witness use, one tiny-budget diagnostic, ten performance invocations containing 18 medium and 12 hard measured workers plus ten excluded warmups, full saved-row/record comparison and report/evidence consumption. Historical native hard runs are on the order of tens of seconds; 35 minutes reserves room for fresh hard repeats, process/JIT setup and serialization. The fixed total includes all required observation/consumption and is not extended for slow code.

covered_risks: Optimization discards exact or incomparable candidates or alters public conditional random semantics.
Timing omits candidate materialization/hashing, mixes output modes, silently uses another checkout, or compares incomplete prefixes.
Historical timing mislabeled as fresh evidence, memory omitted, or finite measured improvement generalized to a universal fastest claim.
Saved candidates cannot be consumed or continued by downstream learning/evaluation code through the public interface.
A finite speedup or a nominal optimization-count target is described as an absolute limit without inspecting rejected approaches, allocation costs and the final bottleneck.
blind_spots: Three fresh hard trials per case/version expose observed variability but are not a statistical proof or a guarantee for other hardware/workloads. Case-level balanced version order leaves within-case temporal drift because three trials are consecutive in the public CLI.

Small independent oracle is exhaustive only for its nine fixed fixtures. Medium/hard complete serialized-state equality is cross-version regression evidence, not a new independent exhaustive hard oracle. Unchanged full rows and record are stronger than comparing product digests, but do not prove arbitrary unsupported cards.

The existing fixtures are already public development material, not a new secret holdout. No universal algorithm choice or absolute optimality follows, even with three or more distinct recorded optimization approaches.
GPU/distributed training, arbitrary unsupported effects, opponent/next-turn planning and desktop UI interaction are outside this own-current-turn CLI journey.

Whole-process peak RSS is not total allocation traffic. Allocation evidence may cover only a disclosed Python/native subset; disclose its scope and any missing total native allocation counts. Instrumented profiling runs do not replace uninstrumented scored performance trials.

Historical acceptance-v2 source manifests retain their actual recorded revision and hashes. Full source equality to 47eb2ef8d843dcc7c20d13f70a2a51eabf21a087 was not established, so historical values cannot substitute for fresh predecessor measurements.
